decisions.reason: As an adjacent niche extension based on existing spraying know-how, the glass flake system still offers learning value and likely modest carrying cost, so we would keep it despite somewhat elevated uncertainty about scale.
The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to our core range and has clear strategic fit, so its option value remains high and the case for withdrawal within the next year is weak.
This multi-model transfer pump line leverages established capabilities and platform economics, making it inexpensive to maintain and unlikely to be abandoned soon.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports our move toward more digitalized customer solutions, but because it is somewhat less central to our traditional machinery base we would keep it with a higher exit probability than the core-adjacent products.
As a very recent launch close to our established offer, the hydraulic two-component spraying system should be kept while early market uncertainty resolves and customer feedback accumulates.
